pb-translation-media.localNotice: Content stays on this device. Turning a switch off does not delete saved records.
pb-translation-media.captionLimits: Microphone only. Speaker labels are yours, not automatic identification. Local recognition speed and language quality depend on your installed model.
pb-translation-media.speaker: Speaker label
pb-translation-media.desktopOnly: Live captions need the desktop app.
pb-translation-media.setupLocal: Set up local whisper.cpp in Connections, Your AI first. No cloud fallback is used.
pb-translation-media.error.CAPTION_PERMI: Record the event host permission in this order first.
pb-translation-media.error.CAPTION_AUDIO: Microphone capture was unavailable. Check device permission and try again.
pb-translation-media.error.REQUEST_FAILE: This step could not finish. Review the current order and try again.
pb-translation-media.error.CAPTION_SESSI: The order or permission changed. Start a fresh session.
pb-translation-media.error.CAPTION_BUSY: Wait for the current local audio chunk to finish.
pb-translation-media.error.CAPTION_TOO_S: Local recognition fell behind. Capture stopped. Use a faster local model before restarting.
pb-translation-media.error.TRANSCRIBE_NO: Set up local whisper.cpp before starting.
pb-translation-media.error.TIER_UNAVAILA: This capture works only in the desktop app.
pb-translation-media.quoteRule: Code counts the exact characters and reserves the reviewed provider rate. This approves only this sentence.
pb-translation-media.listened: I listened and checked meaning and voice
pb-translation-media.dubHelp: Use the approved subtitle sheet. Assign one signed speaker consent and one stock voice per speaker. This does not clone a voice. Every new run keeps a new group.
pb-translation-media.rightsGate: Paid voice calls and delivery remain locked until a named lawyer confirms adaptation rights. Preparation stays available.
pb-translation-media.quota: Provider allowance reached. No further sentence will be sent.
pb-translation-media.handoffHelp: Listen to the complete track. Tell the client this is an AI stock voice. You upload it yourself; nothing is posted here.
pb-translation-media.disclose: Include AI voice disclosure and YouTube altered-content checklist
pb-translation-media.state.failed: Call failed before a known result
pb-translation-media.state.unknown: Outcome unknown. Inspect before doing more.
pb-translation-media.align.extended: Uses available silence before the next sentence.
pb-translation-media.align.overlong: Too long. Shorten the approved translation and create a new group. Audio is never cut off.
pb-translation-media.error.VOICE_MISMATC: Use one exact voice and consent for each speaker.
pb-translation-media.error.RULE_UNCONFIR: A named lawyer must confirm adaptation rights before this step.
pb-translation-media.error.DUB_APPROVAL_: Verify and listen to all audio before approving delivery.
pb-translation-media.error.CONSENT_REQUI: Record current signed consent for every speaker.
pb-translation-media.error.SPEECH_PLANNE: Connect your stock voice account in this dubbing desk first.
pb-translation-media.error.APPROVAL_STAL: The source or approval changed. Review the current group.
pb-translation-media.error.DERIVED_STALE: The source or saved audio changed. Prepare a fresh group.
pb-translation-media.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS: Private dubbing needs a qualified local voice provider. Use manual local preparation meanwhile.
pb-translation-media.error.QUOTA_REACHED: The provider allowance is reached. Check it before resuming.
pb-translation-media.keyHelp: Stored only for this session. Saving makes no provider call. Use a restricted key for your own billed Google Cloud project.
